We need to generate new test cases for getTSIG method, covering other scenarios not covered. Existing test covers when header count zero. Need cases:

- Additional section count >0 but last record not TSIG -> return null.
- Additional section count >0 and last record is TSIG -> return that TSIGRecord.
- Edge: count >0 but sections[ADDITIONAL] list size mismatched? The method uses count from header, then accesses sections[ADDITIONAL] list and gets element at count-1. If list size less than count, IndexOutOfBounds. Should test that scenario? Possibly header count may be inconsistent; but typical usage ensures consistency. But we can test that it throws IndexOutOfBoundsException. However method does not catch; so expected exception.

- Also test when sections[ADDITIONAL] is null? If header count >0 and sections[ADDITIONAL] null -> NullPointerException. Could test.

- Also test when TSIGRecord present but not at last position (i.e., earlier). Should still return null because only last record considered.

- Test when there are multiple records and last is TSIG, ensure correct object returned (same instance).

- Also test when header count >0 but sections[ADDITIONAL] contains null entries? Not typical.

We need to create test cases with inputs: we need to set up a Message object with header and sections. Provide parameter values? Input list includes parameters: maybe "message" is the object under test; but they ask parameter names and values. Could include "message" as variable? Usually test case input includes no parameters; we just configure object. But we can list "message" with description of its state.

Thus each case input can be like:

{
 "parameter": "message",
 "value": "Message with header count 1, additional section containing non-TSIG Record"
}

But value should be a representation; could be JSON string describing configuration.

We'll produce test cases groups: "Message.getTSIG - Non-TSIG Last Record", "Message.getTSIG - TSIG Last Record", "Message.getTSIG - TSIG Not Last Record", "Message.getTSIG - Header Count Mismatch (IndexOutOfBounds)", "Message.getTSIG - Null Additional Section".

Provide expected: null, TSIGRecord instance (maybe "instance of TSIGRecord"), null, exception type.

Make sure JSON format correct: list of groups each with group name and cases array.
